9.7. Signing On a Crewmember
9.7.1. Articles of Agreement
9.7.1.1. Singapore Flag

a)

b)

MPA does not require Singapore Registered ships to update any crew change into

existing crew agreements.

Masters are required to report any changes in the details of a Singapore ship, including

the trading areas (i.e., foreign going), or upon registration with the Singapore Registry

of Ships (SRS), using the Electronic Ship Information (ESI) or Electronic Crew Change

(ECC).

There is no validity period for the reports submitted in the ESI. The report in the ESI will

only need to be re-submitted if there is:

e Achange in the ship’s trading areas; or

e Achange of the ship’s owner or ship manager, together with a change of the entire
existing crew on board.

The Master shall maintain an updated list of the persons on board a Singapore ship

and notify relevant authorities of all persons engaged or discharged on board using an

electronic crew change form as applicable.

9.7.1.2. Flag Administrations other than Singapore flag
Master shall follow the flag administration requirements for crew articles of agreement.

9.7.2. Log Entry

An Official Logbook entry (as appropriate) is required for all joining seafarer. This must be
made on the same day of joining/ leaving the vessel and will include the name and the rank of
the person signed on/ off.

9.8. Overlap

To maintain continuity on board, following factors shall be considered prior planning reliefs:
9.8.1. Following changes at the same time shall be avoided:

e Master and Chief Engineer (If both are new hand in the company)

e Master and Chief Officer

e Chief Engineer and Second Engineer

e New promotions or more in the same department on board the vessel at one time.
(i.e., New Promotion Master, New Promotion 2/O or New promotion 2/E, New
Promotion 3/E on board the vessel at the same time.)

9.8.2. Relief of more than 50% of the complement at one port shall be avoided as far as practicable.
9.8.3. It is company policy to allow sufficient overlap for handing / taking over at the time of crew
